# Irvan

> Irvan (Irvan Fahlepi, GitHub: Mr-vero) is a senior full-stack developer who builds games, quizzes and interactive web experiences, and takes them from first sketch to live: backend, QA on real devices, deployment and analytics.

## Where to look

- [Showcase](https://irvan-fahlepi.vercel.app/): a mini game, a survey, a scroll story, PingPlay Forge and the build behind them
- [PingPlay](https://getpingplay.com/play/feed): a feed of 70 instantly playable HTML5 games, all made with PingPlay Forge
- [The Last Ember](https://mr-vero.github.io/the-last-ember/): a story-driven browser game drawn on canvas with synthesised sound
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Mr-vero)
